title: Snap cuts about 1,000 jobs (16%), citing rapid AI advances
summary: Snap said it is laying off roughly 1,000 staff and closing 300+ open roles, with CEO Evan Spiegel crediting AI for enabling smaller teams.
reason: Explicitly AI-attributed layoff of 16% of a major tech firm's workforce.

title: US Air Force debuts WarMatrix operational AI wargaming system
summary: The Air Force disclosed its first operational use of the WarMatrix AI wargaming environment at a March exercise, with humans retaining decision authority.
reason: Incremental military-AI adoption in planning, human-in-loop.
